race.comment: TEMPESTUOUS (2) settled well back last time out then found the line strongly to finish fourth over 1100m at this track. Will appreciate the rise in trip second-up and will prove tough to hold out. UNBRIDLED STORM (3) finished second last start at the first run back from a spell over this trip at Kembla Grange, beaten a head. In the right race and will prove tougher to run down with that run under his belt and Bullock taking over. DALLAS DUKE (6) is knocking on the door and should be hitting his straps now fourth-up, though he will need a clever ride and a touch of luck from out there. PACIFIC TITAN (10) was doing his best work late on debut and has since been freshened with 35 days. Kept up to the mark with a trial and can launch late. WENDELL (14) was far from his best last time but can bounce back sharply.
